The following events took place in '''187 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 152''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] and '''Year 813''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Events==
*The thirteen-year old [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] performs his [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|Test of Ascension]] in the [[Well of the Dead]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
